description: CNG polnilnice na območju Mestne občine Maribor is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MESTNA OBČINA MARIBOR. Display of locations of CNG refuelling stations in the area of the Municipality of Maribor. All charging stations are intended for passenger cars, trucks and buses. Methane or CNG (compressed natural gas) is used as an effective alternative to gasoline, diesel and autogas (LPG). Coverage: MESTNA OBČINA MARIBOR. The portal shows the English title as "CNG charging stations in the area of the Municipality of Maribor" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MESTNA OBČINA MARIBOR. Its keywords include CNG, Mobilnost, Komunalne in javne storitve, Polnilnica. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
